title: Concept: Environment file points at a default channel
description: environment.yml declares an environment channel list that names `defaults` or `nodefaults`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an environment channel list that names `defaults` or `nodefaults`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through environment.yml (conda).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads an environment channel list that names `defaults` or `nodefaults`.
